info.title: Constellation Simulator API
info.description: State and planning interface for a PlanetScope-like Earth-observation constellation. Plans are submitted to the ground segment and only reach a satellite when it next passes over a ground station (see docs/API.md).

schema.title: Response Satellites Api V1 Satellites Get
Response Stations Api V1 Ground Stations Get
Response Contacts Api V1 Access Contacts Get
Response Opportunities Api V1 Access Opportunities Post
Response List Plans Api V1 Plans Get
Response List Requests Api V1 Requests Get

sigma.title: Sigma
sigma.description: 1-sigma forecast uncertainty; grows with lead time.

times.title: Times
times.description: Either one time (applied to all points) or one per point.

origin.description: North-west corner of cell [0][0]. Rows go south, cols go east.

last_imaged_s.title: Last Imaged S
last_imaged_s.description: Seconds since epoch of the latest image of each cell, or null.

DownlinkActivity.title: DownlinkActivity
DownlinkActivity.description:
Point at ``station_id`` and dump stored imagery for [start, end).

Reserves one antenna at the station for the interval.

ltdn_hours.title: Ltdn Hours
ltdn_hours.description: Local time of descending node (SSO planes).

centerline.title: Centerline
centerline.description: [lon_deg, lat_deg] samples along the ground track.

request_ids.title: Request Ids
request_ids.description: Requests whose target falls inside the strip.

Image.title: Image
Image.description: One continuous strip captured during an imaging activity.

request_ids.title: Request Ids
request_ids.description: Optional tags: requests this strip is meant to serve.

ImagingActivity.title: ImagingActivity
ImagingActivity.description: Turn the (nadir-pointing) camera on for [start, end).

tca.title: Tca
tca.description: Time the target is closest to the ground track.

start.title: Start
start.description: Target enters the swath (along-track frame edge).

coverage_fraction.title: Coverage Fraction
coverage_fraction.description: Area-weighted fraction of grid cells imaged in the window.

station_utilization.title: Station Utilization
station_utilization.description: Antenna-seconds used for downlink / antenna-seconds available.

activities.title: Activities
activities.description: Onboard timeline, including recently finished activities.

OnboardSchedule.title: OnboardSchedule
OnboardSchedule.description: What the satellite will actually do (truth), plus what is waiting on the ground.

OrbitElements.title: OrbitElements
OrbitElements.description:
Osculating/mean Keplerian elements at ``epoch``.

Enough for a client to propagate locally (two-body + J2 secular). ``tle`` is
provided when the simulator can produce one (lets you use sgp4/skyfield).

atomic.title: Atomic
atomic.description: If true, reject all plans when any one is invalid.

sun_elevation_deg.title: Sun Elevation Deg
sun_elevation_deg.description: Sun elevation at the sub-satellite point.

SatelliteState.title: SatelliteState
SatelliteState.description: Ground-truth state of one satellite at ``as_of``.

SatelliteTelemetry.title: SatelliteTelemetry
SatelliteTelemetry.description: What the *ground* knows: last telemetry frame received during a contact.

random_requests.title: Random Requests
random_requests.description: Generate this many random point imaging requests.

uplink_duration_s.title: Uplink Duration S
uplink_duration_s.description: Continuous in-view time needed to uplink queued plans.

opportunistic_uplink.title: Opportunistic Uplink
opportunistic_uplink.description: If true, queued plans uplink at *any* contact with a free antenna, not only during scheduled downlinks.

rate.title: Rate
rate.description: Sim seconds per wall-clock second while running.

min_sun_elevation_deg.title: Min Sun Elevation Deg
min_sun_elevation_deg.description: Imaging produces data only if the sun is at least this high at the sub-satellite point.

transition_time_s.title: Transition Time S
transition_time_s.description: Minimum gap between consecutive activities of different type/target (attitude slew).

SpacecraftSpec.title: SpacecraftSpec
SpacecraftSpec.description: Static capabilities of one spacecraft (SuperDove-like by default).

code.title: Code
code.description: Machine readable, e.g. OVERLAP, NOT_IN_CONTACT, ANTENNA_CONFLICT, OUT_OF_HORIZON.
